selection_rule: All verified registry items with page_count 83 through 90 inclusive; all 107 existing COMPLETE item folders are excluded.

constraints.rights: Recheck exact item location PDM and open access before retrieval.
constraints.retrieval: Anonymous official Wellcome API/IIIF only; documented official presentation routes; no access-control bypass.
constraints.preservation: Every page, raw work metadata and actual retrieved manifest, hashes, Drive fingerprint readback, checkpoint and COMPLETE.
constraints.capacity_gate: Bounded 83-90 page tranche only; do not expand beyond these 16 until exact observed bytes and destination audit are known.
constraints.dedupe: Skip only exact PASS COMPLETE records with drive_readback_verified=true; never replace a verified package silently.
